scope: test candidate requirements; actual configuration and native fixtures remain mandatory
mounts: Exact independently reviewed home/user and existing runtime/dependency mount allowlist only. Reject unexpected nested/ancestor binds, source overlays, host paths, keys, agent or Docker sockets.
network: Exact dedicated candidate policy and rollback after target binding; deny host/peer/DNAT/IPv6 with real scoped proofs while preserving approved DNS/public egress and host-initiated app replies. No bridge-only isolation claim.

fixture.data: fresh TEMP synthetic stores only; no real auth/profile/home mounts
fixture.source: actual immutable candidate image modules, no product overlay
required: official admission and same Page/context recovery without second cap/submit
real DISPLAY frames and frame-bound events
preopened route denial before handoff and on hold/EOF/stale/terminal
private screenshot publication failure, access expiry and deletion
actual USER/NNP/Cap*/mount configuration and wrong-mount fail-closed behavior
exact-SHA independent package verdict and CI gates
native candidate image and effective isolation fixtures
operator safe point and consistent verified backup
exact config/readback, one writer and rollback plan
actual app artifact/resource/binding and authorized visual E2E

rollback: Stop exact candidate, preserve state/unknown outcomes, create explicit distinct baseline maintenance clone from reviewed config. Preserve original stopped object and backup; no blind original start.
continuity: Live Page RAM is lost on stop; container retention does not retain the Page.
